title: Hidden in Plain Text: Emergence & Mitigation of Steganographic Collusion in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Creating a simulated candidate screening dataset ('Uni' and 'Uni-Long') inherently biased to pass candidates from 'The Good University' and fail those from 'The Bad University', and measuring whether LLMs steganographically encode and communicate this university affiliation to maximize reward while bypassing an overseer.

Creating a simulated candidate screening dataset ('Gender') inherently biased to pass male candidates and fail female candidates, and evaluating if LLM agents instrumentally learn to use steganography to covertly communicate the candidate's gender to a receiver model to maximize task reward under safety oversight.
